mentions.name: Charity Record
mentions.description: A web app that tracks charitable donations for taxpayers, supporting tax-deduction workflows such as TXF export and PDF report generation. Built with Django 5.2, Postgres, HTMX and Alpine.js, with Polar for subscriptions, hosted on a DigitalOcean droplet.
mentions.problem: Intuit's ItsDeductible, which the author's family used for years, shut down in October, leaving a gap for donation tracking and tax deduction valuation.
mentions.audience: taxpayers who need to track and document charitable donations for tax deductions
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a charitable donation tracker for taxpayers. My wife and I used Intuit's ItsDeductible for years until it shut down in October. With a little encouragement, I built Charity Record.
